title: Positive-chart affine transitions
statement: Under the hypotheses of [lem-sbc-punctured-completion-affine-chart-transitions], for t : Nat and f : Fin (t+1) \to A, there exists AffineChartTransitions D (t+1) f.

proof.text: Construct M prime and every chart M_i as actual section modules using [def-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-section-modules]. Obtain alpha_overlap and b with their restriction and scalar equations from [lem-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-overlap-localizations], and alpha and d with their C-linearity, pullback and scalar equations from [lem-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-completed-localizations]. Assemble FormalGlueing.Transitions with these fixed modules, then AffineChartTransitions with e and c the identity equivalences. Every displayed field is supplied by one of the two construction results.
